## Checklist

- [ ] Project-specific facts stayed out of skills (they belong in `PROJECT.md` or a rule pack)

- [ ] Any new hook warns and exits 0 (blocking is for irreversible actions only)

- [ ] If the README or a `guide/` page changed: **both** languages are updated (`README.md` + `README.ru.md`, `guide/en/*` + `guide/ru/*`)
- [ ] If a skill was added or renamed: the `guide/*/reference.md` table and Layout tree, `/which-skill` catalog, and prose counts updated
